data.long_meaning: Inji is a name derived from the Arabic language, which means 'gift' or 'blessing'. In Islamic tradition, the name holds spiritual significance as a reminder of Allah's blessings and mercy upon us. The name Inji carries the meaning “Gift, Blessing” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Inji usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, blessing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
